scenes.line1: Why does EF Core slow down?
scenes.say: Why does Entity Framework Core slow down? Can you spot the cause?

scenes.label: Tracking
scenes.sub: Excessive entity tracking wastes memory and speed.
scenes.say: Excessive entity tracking wastes memory and slows your app.

rows.b: Loading too many entities at once

scenes.say: Common issues include N plus one queries, loading large object graphs, and unoptimized SQL.

scenes.title: Check generated SQL
scenes.say: Use ToQueryString to review the SQL your queries generate and catch inefficiencies early.

scenes.question: What happens with a long-lived DbContext?
scenes.right: It can cause memory leaks and stale data from excessive tracking.
scenes.say: What happens with a long-lived database context? It can cause memory leaks and stale data from excessive tracking.
